references.shows: Museum hardware photos show the flat panel, wood side cheeks and grouping of controls above the keyboard.
Roland identifies the 61-key keyboard and programmable six-voice architecture.

silhouette: Broad shallow keyboard with wooden side cheeks, a flat dark control panel and a keybed across most of its width.
features: Wooden side cheeks around a shallow panel
Grouped sliders and a row of square patch controls
Pitch control to the left of the keybed
iconFeatures: Low keyboard with horizontal control panel
Square patch buttons above the keys
avoid: An upright organ or hinged-panel Minimoog
A raised display or manufacturer wordmark

geometry.proportions: Low, wide rectangular chassis, with keys taking up most of the width.
geometry.partLayout: Keyboard below groupings of sliders and square controls. Pitch lever sits at the lower left.

notes: Use the original JUNO-60 hardware and omit logos and tiny legends.
